observations: Two black PlayStation 4 Pro consoles stacked vertically.
The consoles have a textured, matte black finish with visible scratches and scuffs.
The PlayStation logo is visible on the front of the top console.
The consoles are placed on a white plastic bag with 'McSteve' and 'No 1 Online Gadget Store' printed on it.
The background shows shelves with boxed electronics, including smartphones and accessories.
No controllers, power cables, or other accessories are visible in the photos.
The seller claims 'one controller Pad' is included, but no controller is shown in either photo.
